sourceText: Execute Story 2 of the accepted role-prompt modularization plan: trusted full-context assembly and content-addressed Prompt Envelope, continuing until every ordered milestone is DONE.
normalizedOutcome: A Story-aware agent_prompt produces deterministic full-context audit envelopes, signed reviewer flows bind the matching review-run envelope, stale or ineligible evidence cannot satisfy gates, and legacy role-only prompt bytes remain unchanged.
acceptanceClaim: Focused contract, CLI, replay, gate, rollback and zero-drift evidence proves all four confirmed Story 2 milestones without adding incremental, A/B or budget behavior.
